title.zh: Prompt 组装管线完整流程

description.zh: 模拟 build_initial_context() 的完整执行：base_instructions 优先级解析 → developer_sections 逐层追加（权限指令/AGENTS.md/skills/memory） → contextual_user_sections 组装 → 合并为 Prompt 结构 → 发送给 Responses API。每步对应 codex.rs:2306 的实际代码路径。
description.en: Simulate build_initial_context() full execution: base_instructions priority resolution → developer_sections layered assembly → contextual_user_sections → Prompt struct → Responses API.

annotation.zh: Prompt 不是缓存的——每次 turn 都重新组装，确保环境变更实时生效
annotation.en: Prompt is not cached — reassembled every turn to reflect live environment changes

annotation.zh: base_instructions 三级优先级，默认读 prompt.md（500+ 行的模型人格声明）
annotation.en: base_instructions three-level priority, defaults to prompt.md (500+ lines model personality)

annotation.zh: permission 指令序列化为 <permissions instructions>...</permissions instructions>，告诉模型哪些操作需要申请批准
annotation.en: Permission instructions serialized as XML tags, telling model which operations need approval

annotation.zh: AGENTS.md 的内容在这里注入 developer_sections，不是单独的消息——最终合并进同一条 DeveloperMessage
annotation.en: AGENTS.md content injected here into developer_sections, merged into one DeveloperMessage

annotation.zh: core-skills/src/render.rs:5 — skills 列表和使用规则作为 XML 块追加到 developer_sections
annotation.en: core-skills/src/render.rs:5 — skills list and usage rules appended as XML block

annotation.zh: environment_context.rs:171 — EnvironmentContext 序列化为 XML，告知模型当前工作目录、Shell 类型、日期时区
annotation.en: environment_context.rs:171 — EnvironmentContext serialized to XML with cwd, shell, date, timezone

annotation.zh: 无论 developer_sections 有多少层，最终只合并为 1 条 DeveloperMessage 发给模型
annotation.en: No matter how many developer_sections layers, all merged into 1 DeveloperMessage to model

steps.content:
// turn.rs:967 — build_prompt() 组装最终 Prompt
Prompt {
  input,            // 会话历史 + 上述 ResponseItem[]
  tools: router.model_visible_specs(),  // 工具 schema
  parallel_tool_calls: model_info
    .supports_parallel_tool_calls,
  base_instructions, // models-manager/prompt.md
  personality: turn_context.personality,
  output_schema: turn_context
    .final_output_json_schema.clone(),
}

annotation.zh: turn.rs:967 — Prompt 是最终传入 client_session.stream() 的完整结构
annotation.en: turn.rs:967 — Prompt is the complete structure passed into client_session.stream()
